quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a rental car service that lets you pick up in one city and return the car in another with no drop-off fee.
quests.correctAnswer: Pick up in one city and drop off in another, with no hidden fee for the difference - a rental that finally moves the way your trip actually does.
quests.hint: Lead with the flexibility most rental companies restrict.
quests.explanation: Naming the flexibility competitors usually restrict is a direct, effective way to stand out in a fairly commoditised market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that automatically times household appliances to run when electricity is cheapest.
quests.correctAnswer: It waits for the cheapest hour of the day, then quietly runs the dishwasher and washing machine while you sleep, trimming the bill without you lifting a finger.
quests.hint: Lead with the effortless timing, not the technical grid data.
quests.explanation: Automatic, effort-free savings are consistently one of the easiest benefits for any household to say yes to.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family meal-planning app that builds a shared shopping list from everyone's preferences automatically.
quests.correctAnswer: Everyone adds what they fancy, and the app quietly turns it into one shopping list the whole family can actually agree on.
quests.hint: Focus on ending the weekly 'what's for dinner' argument.
quests.explanation: Naming a familiar household argument makes an ordinary planning app feel worth downloading.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a hotel booking platform that pays you double the difference if you find a lower price.
quests.correctAnswer: Find a cheaper rate anywhere else, and we don't just match it - we pay you twice the difference, no questions asked.
quests.hint: Lead with the bold double-the-difference guarantee.
quests.explanation: A guarantee that goes beyond matching the price builds far more trust than an ordinary price match.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace wellbeing app that notices burnout patterns before an employee says anything.
quests.correctAnswer: It quietly notices the patterns - later logins, shorter breaks - that signal burnout, so managers can step in before someone reaches breaking point.
quests.hint: Focus on catching the problem before it's spoken aloud.
quests.explanation: Acting before someone has to ask for help removes the hardest part of raising a wellbeing concern.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart trolley for supermarkets that totals your bill as you shop and skips the checkout queue.
quests.correctAnswer: Every item scans itself as you drop it in the trolley, so you walk straight past the checkout queue and out the door.
quests.hint: Picture the exact moment of skipping the queue.
quests.explanation: Removing a universally disliked moment - the checkout queue - makes the benefit instantly easy to picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an electric ferry service connecting waterfront neighbourhoods as a daily commuter route.
quests.correctAnswer: Our electric ferries cross the harbour in minutes flat, cutting commute time while leaving not a single gram of emissions behind.
quests.hint: Combine speed and zero emissions as one dual benefit.
quests.explanation: Pairing a practical benefit with an environmental one gives commuters two separate reasons to switch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a noise-monitoring app for new parents that translates a baby's cries into likely needs.
quests.correctAnswer: It listens to the cry and suggests what's likely wrong - hungry, tired, uncomfortable - turning guesswork into a confident first guess.
quests.hint: Focus on replacing guesswork with confidence for a tired parent.
quests.explanation: Reducing a stressed parent's guesswork, even slightly, makes the product feel like genuine support.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that delivers a curated new board game to your door every month.
quests.correctAnswer: A brand-new game arrives every month, already vetted by the people who test hundreds so your game night is never dull.
quests.hint: Lead with the vetting, not just the surprise.
quests.explanation: Trusting an expert to filter the choices removes the risk of a wasted purchase and a boring night.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a solo traveller safety app with live location sharing and automatic emergency alerts.
quests.correctAnswer: If you miss a scheduled check-in, trusted contacts get your exact location automatically - safety that works even when you can't ask for help.
quests.hint: Highlight the automatic check-in as a safety net.
quests.explanation: Automating the alert matters because it protects someone in exactly the moment they may be unable to act.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI writing assistant that adjusts its tone to match your workplace's specific culture.
quests.correctAnswer: It learns whether your team writes formally or casually, so every email you draft already sounds like it belongs there.
quests.hint: Focus on fitting in, not just writing correctly.
quests.explanation: Matching workplace tone solves a subtler problem than grammar - it addresses the fear of sounding out of place.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wardrobe app that photographs your clothes and suggests outfits you already own.
quests.correctAnswer: Photograph what's already in your wardrobe, and it suggests a fresh outfit from clothes you'd honestly forgotten you owned.
quests.hint: Lead with rediscovering what's already there, not new shopping.
quests.explanation: Solving a problem with what someone already owns feels smarter and more satisfying than suggesting a new purchase.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a community platform connecting slow travellers who spend months living in each destination.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform connects travellers who live in a place for months, not days - sharing local contacts and know-how that no ordinary guidebook offers.
quests.hint: Distinguish slow travel clearly from standard tourism.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific, growing travel style speaks directly to an audience that generic travel apps overlook.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a returns-management app that books a courier pickup for online purchases in one tap.
quests.correctAnswer: One tap books a courier to your door, so a return never means standing in a queue at the post office again.
quests.hint: Focus on the errand this removes, not the app's features.
quests.explanation: Removing a small, recurring errand is easy for anyone who shops online to instantly appreciate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI subtitle generator that translates a livestream into any language in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: Subtitles appear in your own language while the stream is still live, so language is never the reason you miss the moment.
quests.hint: Lead with the live timing, not just the translation.
quests.explanation: Emphasising 'live,' not just 'translated,' is what separates this from an ordinary subtitle tool.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a private villa rental platform with a dedicated concierge included as standard.
quests.correctAnswer: Every booking comes with its own concierge, so a luxury trip is arranged down to the last detail before you even land.
quests.hint: Lead with the included concierge as the differentiator.
quests.explanation: Bundling a concierge into every booking turns a simple rental into a complete, premium experience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a warranty-tracking app that reminds you exactly when each appliance's cover is about to expire.
quests.correctAnswer: It watches every warranty you own and nudges you a month before each one expires, so you never miss a free repair again.
quests.hint: Focus on the free repair someone almost missed.
quests.explanation: A near-miss is a relatable, slightly painful scenario that makes a small reminder feel genuinely valuable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a co-working space membership that also includes access to a rotating network of city gyms.
quests.correctAnswer: One membership gets you a desk in the morning and a gym in the evening, in whichever city you happen to be working from.
quests.hint: Combine two separate daily needs into one membership.
quests.explanation: Solving two unrelated needs with one subscription makes the value feel greater than the sum of its parts.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a budget travel planning tool that builds a complete itinerary within a set daily spend.
quests.correctAnswer: Set your daily budget once, and it builds a full itinerary that fits it exactly - no compromise on the experience, just smarter choices.
quests.hint: Lead with exact budget adherence as the core promise.
quests.explanation: Staying exactly on budget without sacrificing the experience is the central tension in budget travel, and solving it is the whole pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a school app that lets parents see a live summary of their child's day without messaging the teacher.
quests.correctAnswer: A short summary lands in your inbox every afternoon, so you know how your child's day went without a single message to the teacher.
quests.hint: Focus on the parent's peace of mind, not the classroom features.
quests.explanation: Giving a parent quiet reassurance, without adding to a teacher's workload, is a win on both sides.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a repair-tracking app for shared apartments that shows landlords exactly what's broken and for how long.
quests.correctAnswer: Log the leak once, and the landlord sees exactly what's broken, when it started, and why it can no longer wait.
quests.hint: Focus on ending the he-said-she-said over repairs.
quests.explanation: Removing ambiguity from a common source of conflict makes the tool feel necessary rather than optional.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a business travel platform that keeps every booking automatically inside company policy.
quests.correctAnswer: Every flight and hotel it books already sits inside company policy, so no one is left arguing over a rejected expense claim again.
quests.hint: Lead with the friction this removes for both traveller and finance team.
quests.explanation: Automatic compliance removes the single most common source of friction in corporate travel.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart baby monitor that tracks room temperature and alerts parents if it drifts unsafe.
quests.correctAnswer: It watches the room temperature all night and wakes you the moment it drifts outside a safe range - one less thing to check at 2am.
quests.hint: Picture the exact worry this removes from a parent's night.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific nighttime worry makes an ordinary sensor feel like real, tangible peace of mind.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a resale platform specialising exclusively in verified authentic designer handbags.
quests.correctAnswer: Every bag is authenticated by an expert before it's ever listed, so buying secondhand designer finally feels completely safe.
quests.hint: Lead with trust, since authenticity is the buyer's biggest fear.
quests.explanation: Naming the buyer's single biggest fear - fakes - and solving it directly is the whole pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a guided expedition company running small, immersive cultural trips to remote communities.
quests.correctAnswer: Small groups travel with local guides who share real daily life, not a performance staged for tourists passing through.
quests.hint: Contrast an authentic experience with a staged one directly.
quests.explanation: Contrasting authentic with staged experiences speaks directly to travellers tired of typical tourist attractions.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a noise-cancelling app for open-plan offices that creates a personal quiet zone through your headphones.
quests.correctAnswer: Put your headphones on, and the office noise fades into the background, leaving a personal quiet zone exactly where you're sitting.
quests.hint: Focus on the personal bubble it creates in a shared space.
quests.explanation: A personal quiet zone in a shared office directly answers one of the most common workplace complaints.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that sends a themed puzzle box to solve as a family once a month.
quests.correctAnswer: One box, one evening, one puzzle the whole family solves together - screens off and everyone actually in the same room.
quests.hint: Contrast the puzzle night with an ordinary screen-filled evening.
quests.explanation: Contrasting screen time with shared time gives a simple product a genuine emotional hook for parents.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cultural cuisine tour platform connecting travellers with home cooks for authentic family meals.
quests.correctAnswer: Sit down at a real family table and share a meal, a recipe, and a story that no restaurant menu could ever offer.
quests.hint: Lead with the intimate home setting, not the food itself.
quests.explanation: Home dining offers a kind of cultural access that even the most authentic restaurant simply cannot replicate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a museum app that gives any exhibit an augmented reality tour in the visitor's own language.
quests.correctAnswer: Point your phone at any exhibit, and it comes alive in your own language - culture with the language barrier quietly removed.
quests.hint: Highlight language accessibility as the headline benefit.
quests.explanation: Removing a language barrier opens full cultural immersion to millions of visitors who'd otherwise miss half the story.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart mirror for retail stores that shows how an outfit looks in different lighting before you buy.
quests.correctAnswer: See the exact outfit under office light, evening light, and daylight, all before you ever step near a till.
quests.hint: Focus on avoiding regret after getting the item home.
quests.explanation: Preventing a regretted purchase before it happens is more persuasive than any feature list about the mirror itself.
